_comment: Agent payments' browser tool. Merged into the canonical Autolaunch manifest by Regents.SiteTools; backed by POST /api/agent/v1/autolaunch/tokens/{token_id}/payment/steps and hosted MCP prepare_payment.

tools.name: autolaunch_payment_prepare
tools.title: Prepare a Base revenue payment
tools.description: Review one payment or sweep into a listed Revstake token's revenue split on Base mainnet and return unsigned wallet steps. Only the person's verified linked wallet signs and sends each step. Changes nothing. Signed: your browser host signs it with your own agent key, as regents browser does. Browser sign-in is not agent authority.

token_id.description: The token's id exactly as autolaunch_tokens lists it.

kind.description: pay to pay the amount named into the token's revenue split, or sweep to route everything of the asset already waiting at its payment address into the split.

asset.description: usdc for USDC, regent for REGENT, or token for the token itself.

amount.description: For pay only, and needed there: how much of the asset to pay, as a decimal with no more decimal places than the asset has. Leave it out for sweep.

signer.description: One of my person's own wallet addresses, 0x and 40 hex digits. Omit it to use the wallet they signed in with.
